namedControls: Workspace monitor canvas. Use the monitor and item lists for keyboard selection.

nonMouseSelection.method: SelectionItemPattern.Select on the second item-list entry

numericEditing.method: ValuePattern.SetValue on the X coordinate editor

keyboardKeystrokeTest.reason: Synthetic keystrokes from the elevated automation shell were not reliably delivered to the medium-integrity WPF window. Standard WPF ListBox/TextBox/Button controls are keyboard-focusable; UIA reports HasKeyboardFocus=true for the item list.

limitations: The custom canvas exposes one named automation pane, not per-monitor or per-item automation peers.
The production accessibility design must add per-shape peers or an equivalent accessible object model.
Visible focus styling was not screenshot-verified; default WPF focus visuals are used.
